references.purpose: directional equipment-board layout only; rejected as trader equipment

prompt: Create a modular painted raster EQUIPMENT source board for one Realm merchant animation: a sturdy hand-held brass STEELYARD BALANCE designed to remain readable when reduced to a 35x46 strategy-game actor frame. The tool has a thick horizontal brass beam, one compact hanging weighing pan on short dark chains, a chunky sliding counterweight, a wrapped dark-leather hand grip near the balance point, and a small notched tally marker. No person, hands, garment, table, cargo, goods, coins, sacks, scenery, or text. Art direction: compact painterly pixel-art source material with crisp bold clusters, warm upper-left lighting, dark outlines/edge contrast, restrained brass/umber palette, silhouette clarity over tiny detail, classic 1990s strategy-game readability. Arrange four very large, generously separated views on one board: front/down, rear/up, left-facing side, right-facing side; consistent tool identity, handedness, scale, chain length, and pan size; handle/grip clearly identifiable; every view fully visible and uncropped. Use a perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background with no gradient, floor, shadow, labels, border, text, UI, watermark, duplicate loose fragments, or extra objects.
